wrong: A model reads words, or letters, the way a person does.
tempting: We see words when we read.

wrong: A word the model has never seen makes it fail or print ``unknown''.
quote: it will try to go to the nearest token or maybe it will split further or maybe it will write unknown.

tempting: For common words the two coincide.

wrong: A token id is a meaningful number: id 5 is closer in meaning to id 6 than to id 900.
tempting: Ids are numbers, and numbers have an order.

wrong: The vector of a word changes from sentence to sentence inside the embedding table.
quote: embeddings are same, assume that embeddings are same.

wrong: Each number in a word vector means something nameable, like `sentiment'.
tempting: In a churn model each clue had a name.

wrong: Similar words get similar vectors because someone listed the synonyms.
